analysis_metadata.methodology: Systematic path analysis + boundary condition testing + type safety audit

critical_issues.scenario: LeadStatus type mismatch - store uses 'Propuesta' but backend uses 'Propuesta enviada'
critical_issues.current_behavior: User clicks 'Propuesta' tab → store sets selectedStatus='Propuesta' → filtering checks lead.status='Propuesta enviada' → no match → column appears empty
critical_issues.expected_behavior: All LeadStatus type definitions must align, filtering must accurately show all leads in selected status
critical_issues.impact: Users see incorrect/empty 'Propuesta' column. Silent failure with no error thrown. Blocks Status Filter feature completely.
critical_issues.test_needed: Test that lead with status='Propuesta enviada' appears when 'Propuesta' tab is selected
critical_issues.fix: Align store type definition with backend: Change kanbanFilterStore.ts LeadStatus union from ['Nuevo', 'En contacto', 'Propuesta', 'Cerrado'] to ['Nuevo', 'En contacto', 'Propuesta enviada', 'Cerrado']. Update TABS array label from 'Propuesta' to use correct backend value.

critical_issues.scenario: getVisibleColumns() accepts invalid selectedStatus values without validation (e.g., corrupted localStorage, typos, external manipulation)
critical_issues.current_behavior: If selectedStatus is corrupted (e.g., 'INVALID_STATUS' or 'Nuevoo'), function returns [invalidValue] which never matches any lead.status, causing 0 results to display silently
critical_issues.expected_behavior: Validate selectedStatus before returning. Return ALL_STATUSES or log warning if invalid. Graceful fallback with user feedback.
critical_issues.impact: Silent rendering of empty board (0 leads shown). Corrupted state persists across session reloads. No console error, user confusion.
critical_issues.test_needed: Test that setSelectedStatus('INVALID' as any) either returns ALL_STATUSES or shows error, not [INVALID]
critical_issues.fix: Add runtime validation: Check if selectedStatus is in valid list before returning. If invalid, log warning and return ALL_STATUSES. Alternative: Use Zod/io-ts schema validation.

medium_issues.scenario: User rapid-clicks tabs (Nuevo → Propuesta → Cerrado → Nuevo) while KanbanBoard is computing filtered results
medium_issues.current_behavior: If filteredGroupedLeads useMemo is slow, old and new filters mix. User briefly sees results from combined filter states.
medium_issues.expected_behavior: Each tab click immediately shows results for selected status. No flicker between states. Consistent UI.
medium_issues.impact: Visual flicker during rapid tab switching. Temporary incorrect data display. Especially noticeable on slow devices/networks.
medium_issues.test_needed: Render FilteringTestComponent, fire 4 rapid clicks, verify final selectedStatus is 'Nuevo' and no mixed results shown
medium_issues.fix: Option A: Debounce tab clicks (50ms). Option B: Add loading state during filter transitions. Option C: Memoize visibleColumns separately.

medium_issues.scenario: User tries to navigate tabs with arrow keys (standard WAI-ARIA tabs pattern) but only Enter key is supported
medium_issues.current_behavior: Arrow keys (ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home, End) do nothing. Only Enter key selects tabs. Keyboard-only users must Tab through all 5 buttons.
medium_issues.expected_behavior: WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: ArrowRight=next tab, ArrowLeft=previous tab, Home=first, End=last, Enter/Space=activate
medium_issues.impact: Accessibility violation (WCAG 2.1 Level AA). Poor keyboard UX. Screen reader users confused by tab order.
medium_issues.test_needed: Test ArrowRight/Left navigate through tabs and wrap around at edges. Test Home/End jump to first/last.
medium_issues.fix: Implement full WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: Add keyDown handler for arrow keys, Home, End. Update focus and selectedStatus accordingly.

medium_issues.scenario: Zustand store fails to initialize due to corrupted session, module load order issue, or browser extension interference
medium_issues.current_behavior: App crashes with: 'Cannot read property selectedStatus of undefined'. Entire Kanban becomes unusable. No recovery.
medium_issues.expected_behavior: Show error message to user with recovery option (reload page). Log error for debugging.
medium_issues.impact: Complete feature breakdown if store fails. Poor UX during initialization issues. Difficult to troubleshoot in production.
medium_issues.test_needed: Mock useKanbanFilterStore to return undefined, verify component doesn't crash
medium_issues.fix: Add error boundary/wrapper component that checks store exists before rendering. Show fallback UI with 'Error loading filters - Refresh page' message.

medium_issues.scenario: getVisibleColumns() returns empty array (due to bug or store corruption)
medium_issues.current_behavior: visibleColumns.map() renders 0 columns. Board appears blank with no error or explanation.
medium_issues.expected_behavior: Show meaningful message or fallback to ALL_STATUSES
medium_issues.impact: Silent rendering of empty board. User confusion. No indication of problem.
medium_issues.test_needed: Mock getVisibleColumns to return [], verify error message or fallback displayed
medium_issues.fix: Add validation: if (visibleColumns.length === 0) log warning and fallback to ALL_STATUSES, or show error UI

medium_issues.scenario: Developer wants to reset only status filter while keeping search/priority filters
medium_issues.current_behavior: resetStatusFilter() exists but not obviously discoverable. Developers might use setSelectedStatus('all') instead
medium_issues.expected_behavior: Clear API: resetStatusFilter() intent is obvious. Method is exported and documented.
medium_issues.impact: Low functional impact, but API clarity issue. Developers might use wrong method.
medium_issues.test_needed: Verify resetStatusFilter() works and clears status while preserving search/priority
medium_issues.fix: Improve documentation: Add JSDoc comment explaining when to use resetStatusFilter() vs setSelectedStatus(). Ensure method is prominently exported.

medium_issues.scenario: Triple filter evaluation order (status AND search AND priority) not clearly documented
medium_issues.current_behavior: Filters applied in order: (1) Status, (2) Search, (3) Priority. Correct AND logic but not documented.
medium_issues.expected_behavior: Document filter precedence and AND logic clearly
medium_issues.impact: Potential developer confusion. Currently working correctly but could be misunderstood.
medium_issues.test_needed: Add comment/test explaining filter order: Status → Search → Priority (all must match)
medium_issues.fix: Add comment above useMemo explaining filter pipeline: '1. Status filters by column, 2. Search filters within columns, 3. Priority further filters. Result: AND logic'

medium_issues.scenario: At 375px viewport (mobile), 5 tabs with full labels cause horizontal overflow. All tabs need ~360px+ width.
medium_issues.current_behavior: overflow-x-auto allows scroll. All tabs accessible but require horizontal scrolling. Some tabs hidden initially.
medium_issues.expected_behavior: All tabs visible without scroll, or responsive labels on mobile
medium_issues.impact: Mobile UX degradation. Users must scroll to see all tabs. Minor but noticeable.
medium_issues.test_needed: Test at 375px viewport that scrollWidth <= clientWidth or tabs are responsive
medium_issues.fix: Option A: Responsive tab labels (short labels on mobile: T, N, EC, P, C). Option B: Reduce padding on mobile (px-2 md:px-4). Option C: Scrolling indicator.

low_issues.scenario: User presses Space key on tab (standard HTML button behavior) but nothing happens
low_issues.current_behavior: Only Enter key works. Space key doesn't select tab.
low_issues.expected_behavior: Both Enter and Space activate tab (standard button behavior)
low_issues.impact: Minor a11y issue. Users expect Space to work on buttons.
low_issues.test_needed: Test that Space key selects tab same as Enter key
low_issues.fix: Update handleKeyPress: if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); setSelectedStatus(status); }

low_issues.scenario: When user clicks tab, filtering computes synchronously with no visual feedback on slow devices
low_issues.current_behavior: Filter computes immediately. No loading state or transition shown.
low_issues.expected_behavior: Show brief loading state or fade transition to indicate filtering happening
low_issues.impact: UX polish. On slow devices, might appear frozen. Users get no feedback.
low_issues.test_needed: Test that loading state is shown during filter change
low_issues.fix: Add opacity transition or skeleton loader during filter change. Use local state to track if transitioning.

low_issues.scenario: If user accidentally clicks wrong tab, no undo option available
low_issues.current_behavior: Must manually click correct tab again. No Ctrl+Z or back button.
low_issues.impact: Minor UX convenience. Not expected for Kanban (direct selection is normal).
low_issues.fix: Add history/undo state management in store. Implement Ctrl+Z handler.

low_issues.scenario: Tab buttons have aria-label but no aria-description for additional context
low_issues.current_behavior: aria-label exists and tabs are announced. No description of what tab does.
low_issues.expected_behavior: Could add aria-description for extra context (nice-to-have)
low_issues.impact: Minor a11y enhancement. Current WCAG AA compliance OK.
low_issues.fix: Add aria-description={`Mostrar solo leads en estado ${tab.label}`} to each tab

low_issues.scenario: No telemetry collected for which filters are used (tab clicks not tracked)
low_issues.current_behavior: No event tracking/logging on tab clicks
low_issues.expected_behavior: Optional: Track which tabs clicked, frequency, user behavior
low_issues.impact: Can't measure filter usage. No analytics data. Not required for MVP.
low_issues.test_needed: Future: Add analytics event tracking test
low_issues.fix: Add event tracking: analytics.event('filter_status_changed', { status, timestamp })

Arrow key navigation (ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home, End)
